snippet.title: Myth of Empires: Throne Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Myth of Empires: Throne is a free seasonal multiplayer warfare sandbox. Explore vast lands inspired by many civilizations, tame creatures, forge powerful weapons, and build your guild. Lead cross-server expeditions, conquer territories, and compete for the throne!
#mythofempiresthrone
